answer: To claim a placement, an agent must carry an engraved marble marker to the nadir of a registered crater and set it on a day when the rim gauge reads gale force, the crater warden signing the placement log. Two verifiers match the engraving against the log and the crater survey within a week; a marker claimed twice, or no log entry, closes both accounts. One marker costs 900,000 rupiah, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 markers and 900 million rupiah.
